items.subject: Tailings from a distant mine dump.
items.action: Flowing with water runoff, forming contaminated sediments in dry creek beds.
items.gaze_interaction: The scene's focus follows the path of the water channels spreading across the landscape.
items.setting: The vast, arid floodplain of the Fortescue River basin in Western Australia, scarred by erosion.
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, pale grey sediments, and a dusty, washed-out blue sky.
items.props_detail: A network of shallow, braided watercourses cutting through the red soil.
items.lighting: Harsh, overcast daylight, flattening the landscape.
items.mood: A sense of vast, silent, and unstoppable contamination spreading across the land.
items.narration_anchor: Los relaves del vertedero de Colonial se van con el agua.

items.subject: An official technical report document.
items.action: Lying open on a simple wooden desk, showing diagrams of water erosion patterns.
items.gaze_interaction: The camera's focus is on a highlighted map showing the contamination pathway.
items.setting: A spartan office or research tent in a remote area, 2020s.
items.color_palette: Manila paper, black ink, metallic grey desk, khaki canvas walls.
items.props_detail: A page showing a fluvial map with arrows indicating the spread of contaminants from a source point marked 'Colonial Dump'.
items.lighting: Cool, single-source utility light from above.
items.mood: The cold, factual evidence of a slow-motion disaster.
items.narration_anchor: Un informe técnico lo marcó como la fuente principal y la vía del asbesto:

items.subject: A wide, flat floodplain leading to the distant Fortescue River.
items.action: Showing the scars of seasonal flooding, with debris and sediment deposited across its expanse.
items.gaze_interaction: The eye is drawn along the dry, cracked earth towards the hazy horizon.
items.setting: The lower catchment area of the Fortescue River, under a vast, empty sky.
items.color_palette: Monochromatic tones of dried mud, grey-brown vegetation, and a pale, hazy sky.
items.props_detail: Stagnant pools of murky water lingering in low-lying depressions of the plain.
items.lens_technique: panoramic lens, deep depth of field
items.lighting: Flat, diffuse light from a completely overcast sky.
items.mood: Desolation and ecological ruin, a landscape waiting for the next rain to spread its poison.
items.narration_anchor: la erosión, los lechos de arroyo, las pozas, las llanuras de inundación hacia el río Fortescue.

items.subject: A crust of dried sediment on a riverbank.
items.action: Containing visible, hair-like blue asbestos fibers embedded in the cracked mud.
items.gaze_interaction: The focus is sharply on the unnatural blue-grey hue of the toxic fibers against the red earth.
items.setting: The edge of a dried-up water pool in the Wittenoom area.
items.color_palette: Earthy reds and browns contrasted with the sharp, pale blue-grey of asbestos.
items.props_detail: The delicate, crystalline structure of crocidolite fibers, glinting faintly in the light.
items.lighting: Low, soft morning light catching the texture of the fibers and mud.
items.mood: A beautiful, deadly residue left by the receding water; poison masquerading as a natural deposit.
items.narration_anchor: Fibras azules que el agua deja donde se seca.

items.subject: An environmental scientist, seen from the back in neutral-colored field gear.
items.action: Kneeling to carefully scoop a sediment sample from a dry creek bed into a labeled bag.
items.gaze_interaction: Focus is entirely on the careful, deliberate action of collecting the contaminated soil.
items.setting: A remote, unmarked watercourse in the Western Australian outback, 2021.
items.color_palette: Khaki, red earth, and the grey of the dry stream bed.
items.props_detail: A clear plastic sample bag with a biohazard symbol and handwritten field notes on a label.
items.lighting: Bright, clear daylight of the Australian outback.
items.mood: A methodical, quiet search for a truth that is already known but must be proven again.
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintiuno, una nota ambiental registró fibras en canales de arroyos fuera de la zona marcada como contaminada.

items.subject: The vast, interconnected network of dry riverbeds and floodplains.
items.action: Stretching endlessly towards the horizon, seen from a high vantage point.
items.gaze_interaction: The view encompasses the immense scale of the river system, implying an inescapable contamination.
items.setting: The entire Fortescue River basin, viewed from the air.
items.color_palette: Hazy bands of ochre, red, and brown under a pale, limitless sky.
items.props_detail: The faint, branching patterns of the watercourses
items.lens_technique: wide-angle lens, deep depth of field
items.lighting: Muted, late afternoon light, casting long, soft shadows.
items.mood: The overwhelming and permanent scale of the disaster, a problem too large to comprehend or contain.
items.narration_anchor: El mismo informe advirtió que, sin intervención, el aporte de asbesto a la cuenca del Fortescue puede seguir durante cientos de años.
_f8_slots_scrub: props_detail: like veins across the land.

items.subject: An elderly Banjima man in his 70s, with a weathered face showing signs of illness.
items.action: Sitting alone on a rocky outcrop, his body slightly turned away from the camera.
items.gaze_interaction: He looks out across the vast, red-earth landscape of his ancestral land, his shoulders slightly slumped.
items.setting: A quiet, elevated spot in the Hamersley Range, overlooking the contaminated territory, 2023.
items.color_palette: Deep reds of the rock, dark tones of his clothing, pale blue sky.
items.props_detail: His hands resting on his knees, one gripping the other.
items.lens_technique: 85mm lens, subject isolated against the landscape.
items.lighting: Warm, golden hour light from the side, illuminating the dust in the air.
items.mood: A deep, solitary connection to a poisoned land; the physical weight of enduring sorrow.
items.narration_anchor: Es tierra Banjima. En dos mil veintitrés, Marcos Orellana visitó Australia y se sentó con Maitland Parker, un anciano Banjima.

items.subject: The elderly Banjima man, bearing the signs of illness, his face lined with determination and sorrow.
items.action: Turning his head to face the camera, his gaze steady and direct.
items.gaze_interaction: Looking directly into the lens, his eyes holding the weight of memory and loss, his expression not of tears but of profound weariness.
items.setting: Outdoors, against the soft-focus backdrop of his red, dusty homeland.
items.color_palette: Warm skin tones, grey hair, against the ochre and red of the outback.
items.props_detail: The deep lines etched around his eyes and mouth, telling a story of a long life and a long fight.
items.lighting: Soft, frontal golden hour light, catching the texture of his skin.
items.mood: A quiet, unyielding dignity in the face of immense loss; the human anchor of the tragedy.
items.narration_anchor: «Todavía lloro por mi territorio, pero eso está arraigado en mí; simplemente no puedo alejarme de él», dijo Parker.

items.subject: A simple, hand-carved wooden staff.
items.action: Leaning against the same rocky outcrop where the elder sat, now empty.
items.gaze_interaction: The focus is on the object, a symbol of presence and now absence.
items.setting: The elevated lookout point over the Wittenoom landscape, at dawn.
items.color_palette: Dark wood against the deep red rock, under a soft, pre-dawn purple and orange sky.
items.props_detail: The polished, worn texture of the wood where a hand has held it for many years.
items.lighting: First light of dawn, casting a soft glow on the staff and rock.
items.mood: A profound sense of absence and memory; a life's story left imprinted on the land.
items.narration_anchor: Maitland Parker murió de mesotelioma en dos mil veinticuatro.

items.subject: The modern, geometric facade of the Federal Court of Australia building.
items.action: Standing impassively, its clean lines contrasting with the organic chaos of the contaminated land.
items.gaze_interaction: The camera looks up at the imposing structure, emphasizing its scale and authority.
items.setting: An Australian city, outside the Federal Court.
items.color_palette: Cool greys of concrete and glass, deep blue sky, sharp shadows.
items.props_detail: The coat of arms of Australia carved in stone above the main entrance.
items.lighting: Bright, direct midday sun, creating harsh, defined shadows.
items.mood: The cold, impersonal face of justice and bureaucracy, far removed from the red earth.
items.narration_anchor: Dos años después, Gordon Legal presentó en nombre de BNTAC un proceso contra Australia Occidental en el Tribunal Federal.

items.subject: A permanent blockade of heavy concrete barriers and steel gates.
items.action: Barring access to a dirt road that disappears into the Wittenoom gorge.
items.gaze_interaction: The view is framed by the impassable barrier, looking into the forbidden zone.
items.setting: The access road to Wittenoom, with the red cliffs of the gorge visible in the distance.
items.color_palette: Pale grey of concrete, rusted metal, against the deep red of the earth and cliffs.
items.props_detail: A weathered, faded warning sign bolted to the gate, its text made illegible by dust and sun.
items.lighting: Harsh, late afternoon sun, creating long shadows that stretch from the blockade.
items.mood: A final, definitive act of abandonment; a land sealed but not healed.
items.narration_anchor: Nadie ha empezado a limpiar. En los accesos al pueblo y desfiladero hay bloqueos.

items.subject: A stark, official warning sign affixed to the road barrier.
items.action: Standing as a silent, final statement against the backdrop of the deserted landscape.
items.gaze_interaction: The text on the sign is the clear, sharp focus of the image.
items.setting: The barricaded entrance to the Wittenoom contaminated area.
items.color_palette: White and red of the sign against the dusty browns and ochres of the outback.
items.props_detail: Streaks of red dust running down the face of the sign, partially obscuring the metal.
items.lighting: Flat, shadowless light of an overcast day.
items.mood: The bureaucratic final word on a human tragedy. officially declared closed.
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de un «grave problema de salud y seguri
